name: omp-refine
description: General refinements for Oh My Pi (omp) and pi: Claude-style hotkeys (backslash-Enter inserts a newline instead of submitting, double-Escape clears the draft) — no terminal CSI gymnastics, works everywhere including Windows Terminal.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/refine.mjs test/double-escape.mjs
scripts.coverage: npm run build && node --experimental-test-coverage --test test/refine.mjs test/double-escape.mjs

author: Nikko Gonzales <nikkoxgonzales@gmail.com>
